text: βαίνει ὁ Δεινόσαυρος ἐπὶ τῇ ὁδῷ εἰς τὴν ἀγοράν.
objects: a small woven flax sack, tan with a drawstring, soft and slightly wrinkled, sized to fit in Dinosaur’s hands.
artist_notes: Follow shot with gentle parallax on plants and path stones.
positioning: Dinosaur walks along the cobblestone path mid-frame, three-quarter view moving right, eyes forward toward town.
The small woven sack swings gently at his right side as he walks.
